definitions.explanation: A short, interesting story about a real person or event, especially one that reveals character or is not widely known.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{逸話|いつわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{面白|おもしろ}い→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧{逸話|いつわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{数多|かずおお}く→数多く：12948_kazuooku⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: Many interesting anecdotes remain about this person.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教科書|きょうかしょ}→教科書：01085_kyoukasho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{載|の}っていない→載る：27882_noru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{当時|とうじ}→当時：01615_touji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧{逸話|いつわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{語|かた}り{継|つ}がれている→語り継ぐ：22312_kataritsugu⟧。
examples.english: Though not in the history textbooks, anecdotes conveying the atmosphere of that era have been passed down locally.

notes:
Refers to brief, revealing stories about real people or events. More literary than ⟦エピソード→エピソード：10729_episoodo⟧, which is used more casually.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {逸話|いつわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧ (anecdotes remain)
- {逸話|いつわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}する→紹介する：05641_shoukaisuru⟧ (introduce an anecdote)
- ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{逸話|いつわ} (a famous anecdote)
- {逸話|いつわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{事欠|ことか}かない→事欠く：11484_kotokaku⟧ (no shortage of anecdotes)

Often used in biographies, history writing, and documentary narration. The word carries a positive nuance, suggesting stories that are charming, revealing, or worth telling.
